title: A member who chose pounds sees kilos again on a new phone after signing in
what: The kg or lb answer in setup and in Profile, Units is kept only in the phone settings. The saved profile always says kilos, and that is what goes to the MettleUp account. Signing in on a new phone (Google account or phone number with a saved profile) brings the profile back but never sets the units, so every weight shows in kilos.
expected: The kg or lb choice is kept with the profile and the account copy, and a sign-in on a new phone shows weights in the units the member chose.
how_often: every new phone sign-in by a pounds user
fix_line: Save the units choice into the profile when it changes, and set the app units from the profile when it comes back.

title: Erase all data keeps the light or dark choice
what: Erase says the settings go and the phone goes back to new. It resets the units, AI, tracker and phone settings, but the Light or Dark choice is stored elsewhere and is not reset, so the next person opens the app in the last person's look.
expected: Erase puts the look back to Same as phone, like every other setting.
how_often: every erase after choosing Light or Dark
fix_line: Add the look choice to the settings step of the erase.

items.reason: Settings: kg or lb, language, AI provider and model, voice, speak replies, light or dark, profile goal, experience and targets. Statuses: demo flag, welcome or ready or error, straight-in note, welcome resume. Automations: records check on save, gym look on join or leave, erase and remove-demo clean-up, import undo copy. No plan gate in this area.

Should-reads: units -> every weight on screen, coach, widgets, backup, account copy and a new phone; look -> every screen, widgets, erase; demo flag -> gym syncs, board, Health Connect, badge; erase -> settings, look, reminders, gym link, widgets; remove demo and undo import -> Home, records, chat, account copy; goal and targets -> plans, coach targets, widgets.

Read: units by about 90 screens and the coach, Drive backup, widgets on going to the background; demo flag by the gym syncs; erase clears reminders, widgets, gym link and settings; undo import refreshes Home and records. Not read: units by the profile and account copy; look choice by erase.
Two missing reads: kg or lb never reaches the profile, the account or a new phone (new 01); erase leaves the light or dark choice (new 02). Language has no setter, so nothing to follow.
